name: Geenie MCP Proxy Server
description: Acts as an intermediary between Claude Desktop and Amazon's MCP server to handle authentication, token management, and subscription-based tool filtering. It provides a secure layer for managing access to Amazon tools while facilitating seamless communication between the client and the model server.
